svg.text: Airflow 3.2 on AKS · Cloud Solutions Working Architecture
cloud solutions | rev 0.5 draft | Jul 2026 | helm chart: apache-airflow/airflow
autoscales 0 to N, no idle cost
airflow metadata db · :5432 · sslmode=require · zone-redundant HA
task logs on shared PVC (azurefile CSI, SMB)
scheduler launches task pods via k8s API
secrets mounted into Airflow pods (volumes / env)
access via Microsoft Entra Workload ID (no static credentials)
task pods write logs to the Azure Files PVC, read back by the API server
